Here are the step-by-step instructions to check your SIM card status, reset your APN settings, and reboot your phone safely:

Check SIM Card Status:
1. Open the "Settings" app on your phone.
2. Scroll down and tap on "About Phone" or "About Device."
3. Look for an option called "SIM Status," "Status," or "Network Status" and tap on it.
4. Check for the SIM card status. It should say "SIM Active," "Ready," or similar. If it says "No SIM" or "SIM Locked," please let me know.

Reset APN Settings to Default:
1. Open the "Settings" app on your phone.
2. Tap on "Network & Internet" or "Connections."
3. Tap on "Mobile Network" or "Cellular Network."
4. Tap on "Access Point Names" or "APN."
5. Tap on the menu icon (usually three dots) in the top-right corner.
6. Select "Reset to Default" or "Reset to Original."
7. Confirm the reset if prompted.

Reboot Your Phone Safely:
1. Press and hold the power button on your phone until the power menu appears.
2. Tap on "Restart" or "Reboot." If there is no restart option, tap "Power Off," then wait a few seconds, and press the power button again to turn the phone back on.
3. Wait for your phone to fully restart.

Rebooting your phone will not delete any photos or important data. It simply refreshes the system and network connections.

Please follow these steps and let me know the results of the SIM card status check and if resetting the APN settings and rebooting your phone help resolve the mobile data issue.
